requiredConfig: The complete canonical 8,000-realm trait catalogue from the pinned rules, written once as immutable deployment data.
Recorded game settling start, main start, end, development flag, seed and map center.
Single-realm placement with the original reward profile and open-pool windows.
PlayerRegistry binding and the optional ledger operator with season-pass entitlement.
Realm starting grants, capacities, troops, buildings, resource rules and Labor production.
normalization: Account and entity identities map bijectively.
Recorded execution time is supplied as the oracle block time.

Pool ordinals and sparse allocation indices are internal storage; compare available coordinates, remaining count, duplicate rejections and the next selected canonical realm. Structure owns realm identity and current ownership.
Canonical trait data is shared immutable deployment configuration rather than compiled code; every entry is compared with the pinned catalogue.
Wonder identity, position and realm id are projected from the canonical structure instead of duplicated in a Wonder row.

caseRequirements.season_settlement: Open-entry players draw canonical traits without replacement, settle through the same pool and receive the same immediate troops, production and starting resources; compare all touched facts after each action.
caseRequirements.season_settlement_dev: Explicit canonical realm selection requires development mode, skips ledger and one-entry reservation, permits successive distinct selections, rejects allocated and out-of-range ids, and preserves wonder tiles and metadata.
caseRequirements.season_settlement_ledger: Missing entitlement rejects; a season entitlement settles with recorded realm metadata; a second owner cannot allocate that realm again.
caseRequirements.season_settlement_rejections: Empty name, pre-settling and ended clocks, and selected entry outside development reject without gameplay changes.
caseRequirements.season_settlement_occupied: Occupied initial planner positions are discarded with the original root and salt before a vacant candidate settles.
caseRequirements.season_ledger_pass: A bound owner with the wrong pass kind cannot settle.
caseRequirements.season_ledger_order: An entitlement with invalid Order rejects without gameplay mutations.
caseRequirements.season_ledger_empty: An entitlement without production traits rejects without gameplay mutations.
caseRequirements.season_wrong_mode: The Eternum entrypoint rejects a Blitz game.
caseRequirements.season_triple: Season settlement rejects the three-realm planner mode.
caseRequirements.season_duel: Season settlement rejects the duel planner mode.
caseRequirements.season_pre_main: Settlement succeeds at the settling boundary before main-game start, with immediate provisioning.
caseRequirements.season_explorer_occupied: Season placement skips an occupied explorer tile and leaves the explorer unchanged.
caseRequirements.season_search_limit: Sixty-four occupied candidate draws reject without committing allocation or planner changes.

supplementalCases.world_parity_canonical_realm_traits: All 8,000 immutable native records decode to the same wonder, order and ordered resource traits as the pinned catalogue.
supplementalCases.world_parity_realm_allocation: Sparse swap removal preserves selected ids, paid reservations, original draw salt 71419, exhaustion and game isolation.

harnessCoverage.contractHarness: Paired normal, selected and paid settlements compare facts and rejection outcomes after every action.

reductions: Move the compiled canonical realm table into immutable deployment configuration shared by games.
Remove the Wonder mirror; realm identity, position and wonder eligibility already belong to Structure.
Reuse the existing settlement planner and sparse resource facts instead of a second realm state representation.
Remove the allocation-player map and row: no gameplay or client reader used it, and a consumed reverse index enforces the same reservation guard without a second ownership fact.

ruledDivergences.oracle: Realm provisioning reveals neighbouring biomes; Eternum settlement also reveals village-slot tiles.
ruledDivergences.native: Realm and village settlement reveal only their own tile. All neighbouring native tiles must equal their pre-action state.
ruledDivergences.projection: The paired action snapshots native neighbours before execution and asserts their complete state is unchanged afterwards. Own-tile facts and every other gameplay fact remain paired.

fixtureSetup: Immutable canonical catalogue storage is seeded before gameplay to avoid the test-runner event limit across deployment transactions. All 8,000 entries are checked against the pinned catalogue; initialization and interrupted-deploy gates execute the real entrypoint separately.
The allocation exhaustion fixture starts with three remaining ids in both worlds; gameplay uses the unchanged 8,000-realm pool.
Stationary obstacle realms have no starting resource grants; their ownership, tiles and resource existence remain paired facts.

The 64-draw exhaustion case seeds occupied tiles as planner inputs without constructing 70 unrelated economies. Every seeded tile is compared after rejection; full-structure collisions are exercised separately. The original candidate pool and search limit are unchanged.
